contexts.text: From the life of faith in the Lord (the Most Ancient Church) was called Eve, and the mother of everything living.
The first time, when the Church was in the flower of its youth... was called Eve, from life.
Female = the will... wherefore she was called Eve, from life, which belongs to love alone.
By the condemnation of Eve, is signified the condemnation of the voluntary proprium.

Wild animal (in the Hebrew) is called chajah, and chajah means life; and the very spiritual life of man is in the affection of truth and good... As wild animal, or chajah, in this opposite sense = the affection of truth and good, Eve the wife of Adam is called Chavah from that word... AE 650:9. AE 725:2.
Hence it is that it is said of Adam and Eve...
By Adam's wife is meant the Church, which, because it has life from the Lord, is called Eve, from life...
